gen.rule.basement.count.desc: Number of basement storeys below ground; each adds excavation depth and underground floor area.
gen.rule.basement.count.title: Basement levels
gen.rule.basement.park_min.desc: Minimum length of a parking bay in the basement; shorter bays are not placed.
gen.rule.basement.park_min.title: Minimum parking bay
gen.rule.basement.snap.desc: Grid step to which basement walls and columns snap; smaller steps give a tighter fit to the plan.
gen.rule.basement.snap.title: Basement grid snap
gen.rule.block.corner_program.desc: Use of a plot on two streets that meet.
gen.rule.block.corner_program.title: Corner program
gen.rule.block.far_target.desc: Floor area the block aims for per plot area; sets the storeys of each building.
gen.rule.block.far_target.title: Floor area target
gen.rule.block.fire_access.desc: Farthest a building may stand from a street so that a fire appliance reaches a facade.
gen.rule.block.fire_access.title: Fire access distance
gen.rule.block.min_width.desc: Narrowest buildable area the set-backs may leave; less and the tallest building next to it loses a storey.
gen.rule.block.min_width.title: Narrowest buildable width
gen.rule.block.roof_allowance.desc: Height above the top storey that spacing and sun count: roof deck and parapet.
gen.rule.block.roof_allowance.title: Roof allowance
gen.rule.block.side_setback.desc: Least distance from a plot edge that is not on a street; spacing and sun push it further where a neighbour needs it.
gen.rule.block.side_setback.title: Side set-back
gen.rule.block.spacing.desc: Least clear distance between two buildings of a block; each side of a shared plot edge keeps half.
gen.rule.block.spacing.title: Building spacing
gen.rule.block.storeys_max.desc: Most storeys a building of the block gets from the floor area target.
gen.rule.block.storeys_max.title: Most storeys
gen.rule.block.storeys_min.desc: Fewest storeys a building of the block gets from the floor area target or the sun rule.
gen.rule.block.storeys_min.title: Fewest storeys
gen.rule.block.street_program.desc: Use of every other plot of the block.
gen.rule.block.street_program.title: Street program
gen.rule.block.street_setback.desc: Distance from a plot edge on a street to the building: pavement, entrances and room for fire appliances.
gen.rule.block.street_setback.title: Street set-back
gen.rule.block.street_tol.desc: How close a plot edge must lie to a street or another plot to count as on it.
gen.rule.block.street_tol.title: Edge match tolerance
gen.rule.block.sun_ratio.desc: Clear distance to a neighbour as a share of the taller building's height, for daylight between buildings.
gen.rule.block.sun_ratio.title: Sun spacing ratio
gen.rule.core.door_zone.desc: Space reserved in front of core doors for swing and approach; sets the minimum lobby depth.
gen.rule.core.door_zone.title: Door zone
gen.rule.core.hole_clear.desc: Clear margin around stair and lift openings in floor slabs; added to each opening size.
gen.rule.core.hole_clear.title: Opening clearance
gen.rule.core.lift_inset.desc: Offset of the lift shaft from the core wall; leaves room for doors and services.
gen.rule.core.lift_inset.title: Lift inset
gen.rule.core.lift_room.desc: Size of the room that houses the lift lobby; larger lobbies add core area and waiting space.
gen.rule.core.lift_room.title: Lift lobby size
gen.rule.core.lift_shaft_d.desc: Internal depth of the lift shaft; sets cabin depth and core size in that direction.
gen.rule.core.lift_shaft_d.title: Lift shaft depth
gen.rule.core.lift_shaft_w.desc: Internal width of the lift shaft; sets the cabin width that fits in the core.
gen.rule.core.lift_shaft_w.title: Lift shaft width
gen.rule.core.max_riser.desc: Highest allowed step riser in metres; lower risers mean longer stair runs and a bigger core.
gen.rule.core.max_riser.title: Maximum riser height
gen.rule.core.min_width.desc: Smallest allowed core width; narrower cores are widened to fit stairs and lifts.
gen.rule.core.min_width.title: Minimum core width
gen.rule.core.stair_gap.desc: Gap between the two flights around the stair well; sets the stair well opening.
gen.rule.core.stair_gap.title: Stair gap
gen.rule.core.stair_margin.desc: Extra clearance added around the stair flight inside the core; adds wall and landing space.
gen.rule.core.stair_margin.title: Stair margin
gen.rule.core.stair_width.desc: Clear width of the stair flight; wider stairs enlarge the core and raise evacuation capacity.
gen.rule.core.stair_width.title: Stair width
gen.rule.corridor.hall_min.desc: Narrowest allowed hall or lobby width; narrower halls merge into adjacent rooms.
gen.rule.corridor.hall_min.title: Minimum hall width
gen.rule.corridor.width.desc: Width of the main corridor; wider corridors add plan area and improve evacuation flow.
gen.rule.corridor.width.title: Corridor width
gen.rule.depth.band.desc: Depth of the repeating plan band from facade to corridor or core; sets room depth and daylight reach.
gen.rule.depth.band.title: Plan band depth
gen.rule.depth.facade_min.desc: Smallest depth of rooms along the facade; keeps rooms by the window wall usable.
gen.rule.depth.facade_min.title: Minimum facade depth
gen.rule.depth.inner_min.desc: Smallest depth of an interior room; narrower interior zones are not generated.
gen.rule.depth.inner_min.title: Minimum inner depth
gen.rule.egress.entrance_width.desc: Clear width of the main building entrance; wider entrances improve evacuation and add lobby space.
gen.rule.egress.entrance_width.title: Entrance width
gen.rule.facade.balconies.desc: Adds balconies or loggias to facades, or none; changes the outer envelope and depth.
gen.rule.facade.balconies.title: Balconies
gen.rule.facade.curve_n.desc: Bulge of the north facade in metres; a positive value curves the wall outward.
gen.rule.facade.curve_n.title: North facade curve
gen.rule.facade.curve_s.desc: Bulge of the south facade in metres; a positive value curves the wall outward.
gen.rule.facade.curve_s.title: South facade curve
gen.rule.facade.edge_clear.desc: Margin kept between window openings and facade corners; keeps piers wide enough.
gen.rule.facade.edge_clear.title: Facade edge clearance
gen.rule.facade.gate_h.desc: Height of ground-floor gate openings; must clear vehicles or service access.
gen.rule.facade.gate_h.title: Gate height
gen.rule.facade.gate_w.desc: Width of ground-floor gate or vehicle openings in the facade; sets the vehicle entry size.
gen.rule.facade.gate_w.title: Gate width
gen.rule.facade.glazing_share.desc: Target share of facade area that is glazed; higher values give more windows and less wall.
gen.rule.facade.glazing_share.title: Glazing share
gen.rule.facade.res_sill.desc: Height of the sill above the floor in residential rooms; higher sills leave more wall.
gen.rule.facade.res_sill.title: Residential sill height
gen.rule.facade.res_win_h.desc: Height of windows in residential rooms; with the sill height sets the glazed opening.
gen.rule.facade.res_win_h.title: Residential window height
gen.rule.facade.res_win_w.desc: Width of windows in residential rooms; sets window size on living-room facades.
gen.rule.facade.res_win_w.title: Residential window width
gen.rule.facade.rhythm.desc: Repeat distance of facade bays such as fins or piers; sets the vertical division of the facade.
gen.rule.facade.rhythm.title: Facade bay rhythm
gen.rule.facade.system.desc: Facade type: punched, ribbon, curtain wall, panels or fins; changes the window and cladding pattern.
gen.rule.facade.system.title: Facade system
gen.rule.facade.win_max_w.desc: Widest window allowed; wider spans are split by mullions into several windows.
gen.rule.facade.win_max_w.title: Maximum window width
gen.rule.facade.win_min_w.desc: Narrowest window allowed on the facade; narrower windows are skipped.
gen.rule.facade.win_min_w.title: Minimum window width
gen.rule.facade.win_module.desc: Snap step for window positions along the facade; smaller steps give a finer rhythm.
gen.rule.facade.win_module.title: Window grid module
gen.rule.facade.work_sill.desc: Height of the sill above the floor in work rooms; lower sills increase view and daylight.
gen.rule.facade.work_sill.title: Office sill height
gen.rule.facade.work_win_h.desc: Height of windows in work and office rooms; taller windows bring daylight deeper into rooms.
gen.rule.facade.work_win_h.title: Office window height
gen.rule.facade.work_win_w.desc: Width of windows in work and office rooms; sets the glazing rhythm of commercial facades.
gen.rule.facade.work_win_w.title: Office window width
gen.rule.foundation.raft_thickness.desc: Thickness of the foundation slab in metres; a thicker slab spreads loads but adds excavation.
gen.rule.foundation.raft_thickness.title: Foundation slab thickness
gen.rule.foundation.strip_depth.desc: Depth of strip footings below the base in metres; deeper footings add excavation volume.
gen.rule.foundation.strip_depth.title: Strip footing depth
gen.rule.foundation.strip_width.desc: Width of strip footings under walls in metres; wider footings spread load on weak soils.
gen.rule.foundation.strip_width.title: Strip footing width
gen.rule.goal.adjacency.desc: Preferred distance between rooms that should be neighbours; stronger pulls related rooms together.
gen.rule.goal.adjacency.title: Room adjacency
gen.rule.goal.area_fit.desc: Allowed share of deviation from the target total area; tighter values force a closer area fit.
gen.rule.goal.area_fit.title: Area tolerance
gen.rule.goal.circulation.desc: Target share of floor area used for corridors and passages; lower values leave more usable rooms.
gen.rule.goal.circulation.title: Circulation share
gen.rule.goal.compact.desc: Preferred ratio of building perimeter to floor area; lower values favour compact volumes with less exterior wall.
gen.rule.goal.compact.title: Compactness ratio
gen.rule.goal.daylight.desc: Minimum share of floor area that must receive daylight; higher values favour thinner plan bands.
gen.rule.goal.daylight.title: Daylight share
gen.rule.goal.efficiency.desc: Target ratio of usable to gross floor area; higher values favour compact plans with less circulation.
gen.rule.goal.efficiency.title: Plan efficiency
gen.rule.goal.leftover.desc: Allowed share of unassigned floor area; lower values force rooms to fill the plan more fully.
gen.rule.goal.leftover.title: Leftover space share
gen.rule.goal.light_depth.desc: Preferred maximum depth of a room lit from one side, in metres; deeper plans lose daylight.
gen.rule.goal.light_depth.title: Light depth
gen.rule.goal.room_aspect.desc: Preferred length-to-width ratio of rooms; lower ratios give squarer, more usable rooms.
gen.rule.goal.room_aspect.title: Room aspect ratio
gen.rule.goal.room_width.desc: Preferred width of generated rooms in metres; the plan tries to hit this dimension.
gen.rule.goal.room_width.title: Preferred room width
gen.rule.goal.stair_reach.desc: Target maximum walking distance from any room to a stair, in metres; lower values add more stairs.
gen.rule.goal.stair_reach.title: Stair reach
gen.rule.goal.wet_stack.desc: Preferred spacing between bathroom and kitchen stacks in metres; shorter runs reduce pipe length.
gen.rule.goal.wet_stack.title: Wet stack spacing
gen.rule.grid.column.desc: Column cross-section width in metres; larger columns reduce clear space and add structural weight.
gen.rule.grid.column.title: Column size
gen.rule.grid.column_clear.desc: Clear space kept around each column for furniture and circulation; too large blocks rooms.
gen.rule.grid.column_clear.title: Column clearance
gen.rule.grid.overrun.desc: Distance the structural grid extends beyond the outer walls; adds columns and bays at the edges.
gen.rule.grid.overrun.title: Grid overrun
gen.rule.grid.span.desc: Distance between structural columns along the grid; sets bay size, beam length and column count.
gen.rule.grid.span.title: Structural bay span
gen.rule.light.kitchen_niche_max.desc: Largest kitchen allowed without a facade window, as a niche off a lit living room with mechanical extract.
gen.rule.light.kitchen_niche_max.title: Windowless kitchen limit
gen.rule.massing.arc_tolerance.desc: Maximum deviation when straight segments approximate curved footprint edges; smaller is smoother.
gen.rule.massing.arc_tolerance.title: Arc tolerance
gen.rule.massing.arm_angle.desc: Angle between the wings of L or U footprints; sharper angles give narrower courtyards and corners.
gen.rule.massing.arm_angle.title: Wing angle
gen.rule.massing.atrium.desc: Adds a central open void through the storeys; removes floor area at the core and adds daylight.
gen.rule.massing.atrium.title: Atrium
gen.rule.massing.cantilever.desc: Distance upper storeys project beyond the lower floors; adds floor area above and needs support.
gen.rule.massing.cantilever.title: Cantilever overhang
gen.rule.massing.depth.desc: Overall depth of the building footprint along the y axis; sets plan depth and corridor layout.
gen.rule.massing.depth.title: Footprint depth
gen.rule.massing.floor_height.desc: Storey height from floor to floor; taller storeys add facade and stair length.
gen.rule.massing.floor_height.title: Floor height
gen.rule.massing.form.desc: Overall plan shape: bar, L, U, courtyard or tower on podium; changes how floors wrap the site.
gen.rule.massing.form.title: Massing form
gen.rule.massing.level_offset.desc: Lateral shift of individual storeys listed in the levels array; creates stacked, offset volumes.
gen.rule.massing.level_offset.title: Level offset
gen.rule.massing.level_setback.desc: Setback applied to individual storeys listed in the levels array; creates stepped massing and terraces.
gen.rule.massing.level_setback.title: Per-level setback
gen.rule.massing.roof_overhang.desc: Eave projection beyond the facade in metres; longer overhangs shade windows and extend the roof.
gen.rule.massing.roof_overhang.title: Roof overhang
gen.rule.massing.roof_slope.desc: Pitch of the roof in degrees; steeper roofs add height and change usable attic space.
gen.rule.massing.roof_slope.title: Roof slope
gen.rule.massing.rotation.desc: Rotation of the footprint around its centre in degrees; changes orientation to sun and street.
gen.rule.massing.rotation.title: Plan rotation
gen.rule.massing.setback.desc: Inward offset of the building volume from the footprint edge; shrinks each floor plate by this amount.
gen.rule.massing.setback.title: Facade setback
gen.rule.massing.shell_bulge.desc: How far the skin swells out at mid-height; gives the second curvature of the facade.
gen.rule.massing.shell_bulge.title: Shell swell
gen.rule.massing.shell_clear_share.desc: Least gap of the skin from the floor edge as a share of the stand-off.
gen.rule.massing.shell_clear_share.title: Least clear gap
gen.rule.massing.shell_cold.desc: Largest diagonal gap of a panel that can be cold-bent on the frame; beyond it the panel is hot-bent.
gen.rule.massing.shell_cold.title: Cold-bent limit
gen.rule.massing.shell_concave.desc: Largest offset where the outline is concave, as a share of the radius of curvature.
gen.rule.massing.shell_concave.title: Shell concave limit
gen.rule.massing.shell_crown.desc: Rise of the roof from the eaves to the central opening.
gen.rule.massing.shell_crown.title: Roof crown
gen.rule.massing.shell_dome.desc: Rise of the glazed dome over the opening as a share of its radius.
gen.rule.massing.shell_dome.title: Dome rise
gen.rule.massing.shell_flat.desc: Largest diagonal gap of a quad panel still made as flat glass.
gen.rule.massing.shell_flat.title: Flat panel limit
gen.rule.massing.shell_flat_radius.desc: Radius of curvature beyond which a direction is flat.
gen.rule.massing.shell_flat_radius.title: Flat radius
gen.rule.massing.shell_gap.desc: Gap of the shell skin from the floor edge, for drainage, fixings and cleaning.
gen.rule.massing.shell_gap.title: Shell stand-off
gen.rule.massing.shell_glass.desc: Thickness of the glass of a skin panel.
gen.rule.massing.shell_glass.title: Panel glass
gen.rule.massing.shell_lean.desc: Largest outward lean of the skin towards the eaves, varying along the facade.
gen.rule.massing.shell_lean.title: Shell lean
gen.rule.massing.shell_member_d.desc: Outer diameter of the dome diagrid tube.
gen.rule.massing.shell_member_d.title: Dome member diameter
gen.rule.massing.shell_member_t.desc: Wall thickness of the dome diagrid tube.
gen.rule.massing.shell_member_t.title: Dome member wall
gen.rule.massing.shell_mullion_d.desc: Depth of the mullion on a panel edge.
gen.rule.massing.shell_mullion_d.title: Mullion depth
gen.rule.massing.shell_mullion_w.desc: Width of the mullion on a panel edge.
gen.rule.massing.shell_mullion_w.title: Mullion width
gen.rule.massing.shell_oculus.desc: Radius of the central roof opening as a share of the nearest distance to the outline.
gen.rule.massing.shell_oculus.title: Roof opening
gen.rule.massing.shell_panel_h.desc: Target height of a glass panel; the count is rounded up.
gen.rule.massing.shell_panel_h.title: Panel height
gen.rule.massing.shell_panel_w.desc: Target width of a glass panel along the facade; the count is rounded up.
gen.rule.massing.shell_panel_w.title: Panel width
gen.rule.massing.shell_patch.desc: Free-form patch size: target width of one shell patch along the facade and across the roof.
gen.rule.massing.shell_patch.title: Shell patch width
gen.rule.massing.shell_patches_max.desc: Largest number of skin and roof patches.
gen.rule.massing.shell_patches_max.title: Most shell patches
gen.rule.massing.shell_peak.desc: Share of the height at which the skin swells most.
gen.rule.massing.shell_peak.title: Swell peak height
gen.rule.massing.shell_phase_lean.desc: Phase of the skin lean wave against the eaves wave.
gen.rule.massing.shell_phase_lean.title: Lean phase
gen.rule.massing.shell_phase_swell.desc: Phase of the skin swell wave against the eaves wave.
gen.rule.massing.shell_phase_swell.title: Swell phase
gen.rule.massing.shell_planarize.desc: Rounds of planar-quad optimisation that move panel corners towards flat glass.
gen.rule.massing.shell_planarize.title: Planarising rounds
gen.rule.massing.shell_plant_clear.desc: Height of roof plant the shell roof must clear.
gen.rule.massing.shell_plant_clear.title: Roof plant clearance
gen.rule.massing.shell_rib.desc: Depth of the steel rib that follows the surface along each patch edge.
gen.rule.massing.shell_rib.title: Shell rib depth
gen.rule.massing.shell_rib_inset.desc: Share of a rib's depth that sits behind the surface.
gen.rule.massing.shell_rib_inset.title: Rib inset
gen.rule.massing.shell_rib_width.desc: Width of a shell rib as a share of its depth.
gen.rule.massing.shell_rib_width.title: Rib width
gen.rule.massing.shell_roof.desc: Total thickness of the shell roof build-up along the surface normal.
gen.rule.massing.shell_roof.title: Shell roof thickness
gen.rule.massing.shell_roof_deck.desc: Share of the shell roof thickness taken by the deck.
gen.rule.massing.shell_roof_deck.title: Roof deck share
gen.rule.massing.shell_roof_insul.desc: Share of the shell roof thickness taken by insulation; cladding takes the rest.
gen.rule.massing.shell_roof_insul.title: Roof insulation share
gen.rule.massing.shell_wave.desc: Half the range of the eaves height round the building.
gen.rule.massing.shell_wave.title: Eaves wave
gen.rule.massing.shell_waves.desc: Number of waves of swell, lean and eaves round the outline.
gen.rule.massing.shell_waves.title: Shell waves
gen.rule.massing.sides.desc: Number of sides for polygon footprints; more sides approximate a circle and add facade faces.
gen.rule.massing.sides.title: Polygon sides
gen.rule.massing.span.desc: Size of the footprint polygon used for polygon-based plans; sets the overall length of the outline.
gen.rule.massing.span.title: Footprint polygon size
gen.rule.massing.taper.desc: Inward or outward offset of the volume from bottom to top; tapers or flares the building.
gen.rule.massing.taper.title: Taper
gen.rule.massing.terrace.desc: Creates open terraces on setback levels; adds outdoor floor area and moves the roof edge.
gen.rule.massing.terrace.title: Terraces
gen.rule.massing.twist.desc: Rotation of floor plates from bottom to top; creates a twisted volume and skewed facade.
gen.rule.massing.twist.title: Plan twist
gen.rule.massing.width.desc: Overall width of the building footprint along the x axis; the main size driver of the plan.
gen.rule.massing.width.title: Footprint width
gen.rule.room.apartment_frontage.desc: Facade length one apartment needs; with the footprint width it caps the apartments per floor.
gen.rule.room.apartment_frontage.title: Facade per apartment
gen.rule.room.apartments_max.desc: Most apartments on one floor when the footprint width is open; a given width sets the limit itself.
gen.rule.room.apartments_max.title: Apartments per floor
gen.rule.room.area.desc: Target area of a room in square metres; sets how large each generated room is.
gen.rule.room.area.title: Room area
gen.rule.room.door.desc: Clear width of standard room doors; wider doors add opening space and slightly thicker walls.
gen.rule.room.door.title: Room door width
gen.rule.room.door_wet.desc: Clear width of doors to bathrooms and other wet rooms.
gen.rule.room.door_wet.title: Wet room door width
gen.rule.room.door_wide.desc: Clear width of wide doors, such as accessible ones; used where a larger passage is needed.
gen.rule.room.door_wide.title: Wide door width
gen.rule.room.grow_tolerance.desc: Share by which a room may grow into neighbouring space; larger values give bigger, fuller rooms.
gen.rule.room.grow_tolerance.title: Room growth tolerance
gen.rule.room.hall_area.desc: Area from which a storage room counts as a hall and gets its own zone.
gen.rule.room.hall_area.title: Large hall area
gen.rule.room.min_area_atrium.desc: Atrium area below this is refused; a smaller one is a lightwell.
gen.rule.room.min_area_atrium.title: Smallest atrium
gen.rule.room.min_area_foyer.desc: Foyer area below this is refused; the room is a lobby corner, not a foyer.
gen.rule.room.min_area_foyer.title: Smallest foyer
gen.rule.room.min_area_gallery.desc: Gallery area below this is refused; narrower rooms are corridors.
gen.rule.room.min_area_gallery.title: Smallest gallery
gen.rule.room.min_area_public_hall.desc: A hall outside a dwelling below this area is refused; a smaller one is the corridor.
gen.rule.room.min_area_public_hall.title: Smallest public hall
gen.rule.room.min_fill.desc: Narrowest strip used when filling leftover plan space with rooms; thinner gaps stay empty.
gen.rule.room.min_fill.title: Minimum fill width
gen.rule.room.min_unit.desc: Smallest room width; narrower rooms are merged with neighbouring space.
gen.rule.room.min_unit.title: Minimum room width
gen.rule.site.canopy.desc: Adds a canopy over the entrance or facade; extends the envelope and shades the entry.
gen.rule.site.canopy.title: Entrance canopy
gen.rule.site.paving.desc: Width of the paved strip around the building; sets how far hard surface extends from the walls.
gen.rule.site.paving.title: Paving width
gen.rule.site.plot_setback.desc: Distance from the plot boundary to the building; keeps the footprint away from property lines.
gen.rule.site.plot_setback.title: Plot setback
gen.rule.site.tree_mix.desc: Which kinds of trees the site is planted with: a mix of broadleaf, conifer, columnar and small trees, broadleaf only, conifers, street trees or palms and spreading trees for dry climates.
gen.rule.site.tree_mix.title: Tree mix
gen.rule.site.tree_season.desc: Season the site trees stand in: summer leaf, autumn colour, bare winter branches or young spring leaf and blossom; evergreens keep their look.
gen.rule.site.tree_season.title: Tree season
gen.rule.site.landscape.desc: Whether a site with paving or trees also gets a hedge, beds with shrubs, lawn and paths to the street.
gen.rule.site.landscape.title: Landscape
gen.rule.site.street_side.desc: The side of the plot the street lies on: the paths lead there, the street trees stand along it.
gen.rule.site.street_side.title: Street side
gen.rule.site.plot_margin.desc: Free ground between the paving and the plot boundary where the hedge stands.
gen.rule.site.plot_margin.title: Plot margin
gen.rule.site.hedge.desc: The hedge along the plot boundary: none, clipped, low, tall, conifer, or of hornbeam, privet or yew.
gen.rule.site.hedge.title: Hedge
gen.rule.site.bed_width.desc: Width of the planting bed with shrubs outside the paving; zero leaves no bed.
gen.rule.site.bed_width.title: Bed width
gen.rule.site.path_width.desc: Width of the paths from the entrances to the street.
gen.rule.site.path_width.title: Path width
gen.rule.site.tree_setback.desc: Least distance from the building to a tree trunk.
gen.rule.site.tree_setback.title: Tree setback
gen.rule.site.tree_building_clear.desc: Least gap between a tree crown and the walls and eaves.
gen.rule.site.tree_building_clear.title: Tree clearance from the building
gen.rule.site.tree_size_jitter.desc: How much each tree may be larger or smaller than its species type.
gen.rule.site.tree_size_jitter.title: Tree size spread
gen.rule.site.tree_min_clear.desc: Least clear height under the crown of a site tree.
gen.rule.site.tree_min_clear.title: Clear trunk under trees
gen.rule.site.tree_path_clear.desc: Least free distance between a tree trunk and a path.
gen.rule.site.tree_path_clear.title: Tree clearance to paths
gen.rule.site.tree_rows.desc: Rows of trees along the street edge of the plot, along the paths to the street, or both.
gen.rule.site.tree_rows.title: Tree rows
gen.rule.site.row_spacing.desc: Distance between the trees of a row.
gen.rule.site.row_spacing.title: Row spacing
gen.rule.site.trees.desc: Number of trees placed around the building on the site; adds greenery and site objects.
gen.rule.site.trees.title: Tree count
gen.rule.span.fy.desc: Yield strength of the steel; a member resists at most this stress times its area.
gen.rule.span.fy.title: Steel yield strength
gen.rule.span.util_max.desc: Largest ratio of load effect to resistance accepted in any member under the factored combinations.
gen.rule.span.util_max.title: Largest section utilisation
gen.rule.span.gamma_dead.desc: Factor on permanent load (self weight, deck, surfacing) in the strength combinations.
gen.rule.span.gamma_dead.title: Permanent load factor
gen.rule.span.gamma_live.desc: Factor on imposed load (crowd, snow) in the strength combinations.
gen.rule.span.gamma_live.title: Imposed load factor
gen.rule.span.gamma_wind.desc: Factor on wind in the strength combinations.
gen.rule.span.gamma_wind.title: Wind load factor
gen.rule.span.psi.desc: Share of the imposed load that acts together with wind.
gen.rule.span.psi.title: Combination factor
